handoff: Approve: tidy prunes old hook files (B28) and not-live runs' briefings/transcripts (B29), never a live run's or workflows/backfill/caches/locks (B30); dry-run and idempotence covered (B31, B32). AC1–AC4 tested at S1; housekeeping 24/24, test:fast 907/907, typecheck green. Two nits only.

findings.title: statOrNull swallows every error
findings.detail:
statOrNull catches all errors (EACCES, EIO included) and returns null, so an unreadable hook file or run dir is silently skipped; listDir next to it rethrows anything but ENOENT/ENOTDIR. Skipping is harmless here (nothing is deleted), but the two helpers disagree.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Return null only for ENOENT/ENOTDIR, as listDir does.

findings.title: deleteTracePaths computes the parent from the unchecked path
findings.detail:
rmSync uses safeRel(rel) but the empty-parent check uses join(traceDir, rel). Since safeRel throws first on an escaping path this is not exploitable; it just reads inconsistently.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Compute safeRel once and use it for both.
